items.title: 3 High Quality Dividend Stocks For Steady Income In Higher Rate Markets
items.summary: Rate hikes, stubborn inflation and policy headlines are reshaping the income corner of the market, and that mix is putting high-quality dividend-paying stocks in the spotlight for investors who care about both cash flow and resilience. Miss the right opportunities and you risk watching others collect steady payouts while you sit on the sidelines. This article walks through three stocks from our screener that appear positively exposed to these shifts at the moment. The three individual stocks...

items.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We Think Twice About
items.summary: Regarded as defensive investments, consumer staples stocks are generally safe bets in choppy markets. The flip side is that they frequently fall behind growth industries when times are good, and this was the reality over the past six months as the sector’s flat performance trailed the S&P 500’s 16.2% gain.

items.title: Brown Forman (BF.B) CEO Lawson Whiting Announces Retirement
items.summary: Brown-Forman (NYSE: BF.B) CEO Lawson E. Whiting announced his retirement as the company faces weaker sales and operational pressures. The board has started a succession process to identify Whiting's successor and manage the leadership transition. The change at the top comes as Brown-Forman deals with ongoing headwinds in its core markets and reviews its long term direction. This kind of leadership change at a major consumer stock often pushes investors to reassess income-focused holdings...
